Define nested public static final DTO classes `AddressCommand` (`String street`, `String city`) and `NewProfileCommand` (`String name`, `int age`, `AddressCommand address`, `List<String> emails`) with public constructors and getters. Define immutable nested public static final domain classes `Address` and `Profile` with getters for the corresponding fields.

Implement `public static Address mapAddress(AddressCommand command)` and `public static Profile mapProfile(NewProfileCommand command)`. Null commands must throw `IllegalArgumentException`. A profile must have a non-null address and email list; the list must contain no null elements. Invalid profile input throws `IllegalArgumentException`. Preserve email order and duplicates. The returned profile must contain an unmodifiable snapshot of the emails, so later mutation of the command's list has no effect. Mapping must not mutate its arguments. Strings and age are copied without validation or normalization.
